question_text: Determine the amounts and compositions of each microconstituent in a $\mathrm{Pb}-30 \%$ Sn alloy immediately after the eutectic reaction has been completed. Give your answer as a tuple: (amount_primary_alpha, amount_eutectic)The units of each required answer are (%, %), respectively.
response:
For a hypoeutectic Pb–30% Sn alloy, at the eutectic temperature the compositions are: α = 19.2% Sn, liquid → eutectic = 61.9% Sn. Applying the lever rule:

$$W_{\alpha_p} = \frac{61.9-30}{61.9-19.2}=74.7\%,\quad W_{\text{eut}}=\frac{30-19.2}{61.9-19.2}=25.3\%$$

$$\boxed{(74.7,\ 25.3)}$$
